description: Roque Nublo stands silhouetted against the stars, the great basalt monolith rising from the volcanic ridge below. Thin drifting cloud (20% model cover) softens parts of the sky, and far across the dark sea the silhouette of Mount Teide on Tenerife closes the horizon. A high-plateau night at its starkest — nothing lit but the stars.
